summary: Frontend-only auth flow testing for UI Guidelines CMS. All 6 requested scenarios passed: unauth gating (/, /users -> /login), invalid credentials show error alert and stay on /login, login by EMAIL redirects to /, sidebar footer shows 'Administrator' and 'admin@example.com', token stored in localStorage 'app.token', session persistence across reload via /api/auth/me, logout redirects to /login and re-gates protected routes, login by USERNAME 'admin' also succeeds. No crashes, no console errors beyond expected 401 for the invalid-credentials case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow (login by email/username, invalid creds, session persistence via /api/auth/me, logout, route-guarding) is fully working end-to-end. Token key 'app.token' verified. Sidebar shows real user (Administrator / admin@example.com). Toast 'Signed in successfully' also confirmed. Next iteration can focus on CMS features (Users/Roles/Offices/Clients/Branding/Broadcast/Database/Audit Log) since the loading skeletons on dashboard were still visible in the screenshot but were not part of this scope.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found in scope.
